physical_approximation: Common tree-level zero-momentum matching at 8.374 TeV above the split weak gate in the two nondegenerate Dirac-cluster basis. VEV/sqrt(2) as a dimension conversion. Flavor congruence propagated through the original charged model; a common universal Wilson running factor is taken as one for quoting absolute eV spurions. Pole-specific loop and threshold matching need additional sources. Condition on same nonoscillation Dirac assets; two-frequency-profiled endpoint used only as a comparison.
